title: Diploma In Business Management (Level 3)
description: This diploma qualifies individuals to assess business management, and understanding in professional work environments.
longDescription: This Level 3 qualification in Business Management is designed to align with industry standards and best practices, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of assessment principles and quality assurance processes. Developed in consultation with educational experts and sector professionals, it provides learners with the knowledge, skills, and competencies required to assess business-related knowledge and skills effectively. The qualification prepares learners to apply assessment techniques in diverse settings, such as classrooms, workshops, or professional training environments. Time Table The programme runs from 26 October 2026 to 26 July 2027, covering six academic learning and assessment periods. Teaching includes guided lectures, practical activities, case studies, group discussions, independent study and assignment preparation. A Winter Vacation is scheduled from 21 December 2026 to 8 January 2027, followed by a Spring Vacation from 29 March to 16 April 2027. The final period focuses on assignment completion, assessment, quality assurance, academic review and confirmation of programme completion, with results processed in August 2027.
courseDetails: The objective of the ISM Level 3 Diploma in Business Management qualification is to provide learners with an in-depth understanding of the operations and structure of businesses. The qualification will provide learners with the underpinning knowledge, understanding and skills associated with business activities. It will prompt research, investigation and review of aspects of business which include Business Communication, The Business Environment, People Management, Customer Service, Finance and Marketing. After completing ISM Level 3 Diploma in Business Management a learner should be able to demonstrate and/or work with: Knowledge and Understanding ● An appreciation of the body of knowledge that constitutes a discipline of business. ● A range of knowledge, facts, theories, ideas, properties, materials, terminology, practices and techniques about, and associated with, business , its functions and its context. ● Apply knowledge, skills and understanding using some of the basic, routine practices, techniques to address set situations and/or problems related to the business management of organisations. ● Relating field of business, functions of business, industries, sector to a range of practical and/or commonplace applications.

modules.title: Level 3 - Communication For Business
modules.summary: This module develops effective communication skills, focusing on business writing, presentations, and interpersonal communication to support professional interactions in diverse business environments.

modules.title: Level 3 - Customer Service
modules.summary: Students will learn the principles of delivering exceptional customer service, focusing on customer satisfaction, relationship management, and problem-solving in a business context.

modules.title: Level 3 - Finance In Business
modules.summary: This module covers key financial concepts, including budgeting, financial planning, and interpreting financial statements to make informed business decisions.

modules.title: Level 3 - Marketing
modules.summary: An introduction to core marketing principles, including market research, segmentation, branding, and promotional strategies to attract and retain customers.

modules.title: Level 3 - People Management
modules.summary: This module introduces strategies for managing people effectively, including recruitment, motivation, leadership, and team development to achieve organizational goals.

modules.title: Level 3 - The Business Environment
modules.summary: Students will explore the internal and external factors influencing businesses, including economic, social, and legal environments, to understand how organizations operate and adapt.
